meta.name: paid-ads-setup
meta.description: Connect NotFair paid-ad accounts and establish reusable campaign context. Use when setting up paid media in a new workspace, connecting Google or Meta, refreshing brand context, or preparing an agent to work on ads safely.

copy.tagline: 连接广告账户，搭建可复用的投放环境
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你刚接手广告账户，需要快速完成与平台的对接配置。
copy.tagline_en: Connect ad accounts and set up reusable campaign context for paid media.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to connect paid ad accounts and prepare an agent to manage ads safely.

howto.what: 连接NotFair付费广告账户（如Google、Meta），读取相关项目资料，收集产品、预算、转化目标等背景，不修改现有广告活动；最后生成差距清单，指出缺失信息并给出最小下一步。
howto.when: 当你要在新工作区设置付费广告、连接广告平台（如Google或Meta）、或刷新品牌背景时触发。

say.text: 帮我连接Google Ads账户并读取当前账户列表
say.note: 它会先检查连接是否可用并列出账户

say.text: 收集我们产品的目标CPA和月预算，用于广告设置
say.note: 它会读取项目文档并补充关键问题

say.text: 检查所有广告平台连接并生成差距登记
say.note: 它会报告缺失的跟踪或经济数据

howto.what_en: Connects NotFair paid-ad accounts (e.g., Google, Meta), reads relevant project docs, collects product, budget, conversion targets, and does not alter live campaigns; ends with a gap register listing missing info and the smallest next step.
howto.when_en: Triggers when setting up paid media in a new workspace, connecting Google or Meta, refreshing brand context, or preparing an agent to work on ads safely.

say_en.text: Connect my Google Ads account and list the available accounts.
say_en.note: It checks connectivity first and lists accounts.

say_en.text: Collect our target CPA and monthly budget for ad setup.
say_en.note: It reads project docs and asks key questions.

say_en.text: Check all ad platform connections and produce a gap register.
say_en.note: It reports missing tracking or economics data.
